cleanup.exportFirst: In Calendar choose File > Export > Calendar Archive to save every calendar, then copy the archive off this Mac.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of the calendar account in System Settings > Apple Account or Internet Accounts, so events stay with the account.
steps: Open Calendar and check that every calendar under On My Mac is covered by the export.
Quit Calendar so its folders are no longer in use.
Delete the folder named in the plan if it still exists.
Empty the Trash so the deleted events cannot be recovered.
cleanup.risk: Local copies of events, notes and attachments are lost; anything held only on this Mac is gone for good.
cleanup.source: Apple Support, Import or export calendars on Mac: https://support.apple.com/guide/calendar/import-or-export-calendars-icl1023/mac
